question_summary: Concrete grade beam at Gridline D/7 clashes with underground electrical duct bank, plumbing sanitary main, and mechanical condensate drain; resolution needed before fabrication release.
proposed_solution: Hold fabrication release at Gridline D/7 pending a coordination sketch resolving the clash.
deadline_text: A response within three weeks would be appreciated.
routing_rationale: The grade beam is a structural element and the clash resolution requires structural redesign coordination with MEP trades, so the structural EOR should lead the response.
